subject: general
question:
The runs scored by 11 players in the cricket match are as follows.

7, 16, 121, 51, 101, 81, 1, 16, 9, 11, 16

Calculate the median of the data.
solution:
**Given:**

The runs scored by 11 players in a cricket match are: 7, 16, 121, 51, 101, 81, 1, 16, 9, 11, 16

**Formula used:**

Median is the middle value in an ordered list of numbers.

If the number of observations (n) is odd, the median is the value at position ((n+1)/(2))

**Calculation:**

First, order the data in ascending order:

1, 7, 9, 11, 16, 16, 16, 51, 81, 101, 121

Number of observations (n) = 11

Position of the median = ((11+1)/(2))

⇒ Position of the median = 6

The value at the 6th position is 16.

**∴ The median of the data is 16.**
